name: alm-bench-mcq-subset
description: A subset of a larger multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark designed to evaluate language models on selection-style question answering. It contains curated MCQs across topics to measure models' comprehension and factual/commonsense reasoning as reflected by choosing the correct option.
reputation: A small, user-published MCQ subset with limited community adoption compared to larger, well-known MCQ benchmarks.
